correctness.rationale: PASS: The statement fixes positive weights summing to one, N>=2, positive weighted mean and a negative node. Derivation factors u=(m+a)p-a1 and L=mp, bounds the ray displacement by the smallest remaining quadrature weight and every conservative feasible correction below by weighted Cauchy--Schwarz. Their quotient is maximized by the two smallest weights. An explicit family with one small negative component and a small positive buffer elsewhere reaches the bound, with the exact metric projection obtained by KKT thresholding. The LGL endpoint formula gives N(N-1)-1. Exact-rational checks independently exercise the formulas; no finite run is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: PASS: This is a natural and actionable numerical-design invariant: it quantifies exactly how much perturbation a commonly used, cheap positivity limiter can cause relative to the best correction respecting the same nodal positivity and conservative mean. The quadratic growth N(N-1)-1 at standard LGL nodes is a structural, unbounded-in-degree limitation not conveyed by the routine fact that orthogonal projection minimizes distance, and directly motivates alternative corrections or weight-aware analysis. It does not claim a downstream PDE error theorem or transfer to additional entropy constraints.
